title: Benefit realisation: measure set, monthly timing, month key, screen and requirement ID are not fixed by any source
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3 (RWB-E6-037); FSD P9 Reporting v3 A2.6; TSD P9 Reporting v2 T3.1 and T-A; Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8
section: RWB-E6-037 Story and Acceptance criteria AC1; FSD P9 A2.6 (FEAT-RPT-06); TSD P9 T3.1 measure_snapshot, T-A.2 API-P9-001
description: RWB-E6-037 says only that the measures of the benefit model are tracked against the baseline, monthly, and the FSD P9 A2.6 repeats it. No source enumerates which measure codes belong to the benefit model (the baseline of RWB-E1-013 holds six measures and the steering set of RWB-E2-009 holds seven, neither is called the benefit model), which business day runs the monthly step, how a month is keyed in measure_snapshot when the table carries business_date and no month column, which screen the Finance and CFO delegate uses (the legacy story says no screen, and the only P9 screen is SCR-37 Steering dashboard, owned by RWB-E2-009), or which requirement ID the legacy story traces to. The story is written with one assumed default per value, each recorded as an assumption row, and the citations stand until step D1 numbers them.
evidence: RWB-E6-037 (Story, AC1, Data, Endpoints); FSD P9 A2.6 AC-P9-006-01; TSD P9 T3.1 DF-RPT-041 to DF-RPT-052; TSD P9 T3.2 LOV-MEASURE-DIM; RWB-P9-E1013-APP (six baseline measures, MD-2026.11, baseline of 2026-11-27); RWB-P9-E2009-APP (seven steering measures, SCR-37)
proposed: Confirm the benefit-model measure set and where its membership is held, the business day and cut-off of the monthly step, the month key in measure_snapshot, the screen that carries the benefit view, and the requirement ID the legacy key traces to

title: Benefit realisation: the variance fields, the variance rule, the row ceiling, the event absence and the baseline date default are not fixed by any source
source: RWB-E6-037; FSD P9 Reporting v3 A2.6; TSD P9 Reporting v2 T-A.2; Template and Rules v1 §R4 and §R5.5
section: RWB-E6-037 Endpoints (GET /api/recovery/v1/reports/measures); TSD P9 T-A.2 API-P9-001 (Response Measure[]); TSD P9 T3.1 measure_snapshot
description: The legacy story names one read, GET /reports/measures, and the TSD gives its response as Measure[] with no field list beyond measure, product, route, period and value. No source names the properties that carry the comparison (baselineValue, variance, variancePercent), the arithmetic of the variance and of its percentage, the ceiling of the answer when no paging is declared, the baseline date a caller may ask for and its default, or whether the service publishes an event type of its own (the ownership rows carry none, while the wave 1 integration harness names rwb.reporting.ReportPublished.v1 as the marker of the Epic 1 measure run). The contract is written with one assumed default per value, each recorded as an assumption row.
evidence: RWB-E6-037 Endpoints; TSD P9 T-A.2 (Request: measure, product, route, from, to; Response: Measure[]); TSD P9 T3.1; RWB-PLT-DB-01-N008 (rwb.reporting.events.v1 / ReportPublished); RWB-ITG-E1013-ITG (ReportPublished of the E1 measure run); RWB-P9-E2009-APP section 12.3 (no event type of the service's own)
proposed: Confirm the three comparison properties, the variance arithmetic, the ceiling of the answer, the baseline date parameter and its default, and whether rwb-reporting publishes an event type of its own
